notes: Alliant Techsystems merged with Orbital Sciences to form Orbital ATK, later absorbed by Northrop Grumman; local Norgate carries the continuous lineage under active NOC.
Harris Corp merged with L3 Technologies to form L3Harris; local Norgate carries the continuous lineage under active LHX.
Intelsat moved from NYSE ticker I to OTC ticker INTEQ before equity cancellation.
Lilium moved from NASDAQ ticker LILM to active OTC ticker LILMF.
Loral Space and Communications merged into Telesat Corporation; local Norgate carries the continuous lineage under active TSAT.
United Technologies merged with Raytheon to form Raytheon Technologies; local Norgate carries the continuous lineage under active RTX.
